_week: 2026-10-19 to 2026-10-25 (Week 43, Monday–Sunday). Written from that week's numbers; rewrite every key each Monday.
week_story: Revenue fell to $57.7K (-26%) almost entirely on Octaspring Queen: 8 units vs 65 the week before, with 0 available at FBA and 400 inbound.
The in-stock toppers grew: Full +55%, Cal/Split/RV +52%, Twin & XL +23%, King +2%.
refunds: Refunds were $12.1K, 26.1% of revenue, up from 17.6% last week. Part of this is Prime Big Deal Days orders coming back, but the rate has now risen two weeks in a row.
pacing_reco: Getting the Queen topper checked in at FBA is still the biggest lever: it was the top seller before the stock-out and is now under 6% of sales.
ads_context: Ad spend came down 30% to $6.7K while ACoS held at 23.7% (23.9% last week).
TACoS was 11.7%; ads drove 49% of revenue this week.
ads_strategy: Branded keywords returned $19.8K on $3.2K (16.2% ACoS) and brought 63 of 85 ad orders.
Category keywords cost $1.5K for $4.1K in sales (36.9% ACoS); spend there was cut 51% vs last week.
Streaming TV spent $1.1K for one $495 sale.
bid_moves: Lower the bid on “mattress +topper” (phrase): $1,003 spent for 4 orders (76% ACoS).
Cut or pause the 97 campaigns that spent $792 this week with no sales; the top five are each $40–60.
coupons: October to date: 127 coupon redemptions, all before Oct 12.
promotions: This week: 8 promotion orders, $258 in promotional discounts (vs 27 orders and $631 last week).
Discounting keeps stepping down, which protects margin while the Queen is out of stock.
events: Black Friday / Cyber Monday: Nov 27 – Nov 30.
Deal and coupon set-up deadlines: to confirm with the account team.
Priority: Queen and King toppers in stock at FBA before Nov 20 so BF/CM traffic converts.
reviews_body: Sellerise returned no review records for Dormeo US over the last 90 days.
That means review tracking isn't pulling for this account, not that there were no reviews.
reviews_reco: Turn on review tracking for Dormeo US in Sellerise (or pull Amazon's Customer Reviews report) so the deck can show star rating and review count per line.
With refunds at 26.1%, reading the newest 1–3 star reviews on the King and Full toppers is the quickest way to see whether returns share a cause.

Send King (1.6 weeks available) and Cal/Split/RV (2.7 weeks) replenishment so neither runs out before BF/CM.
Lower the bid on “mattress +topper” (phrase) and review the $1.1K Streaming TV spend that returned one sale.
